title: 2024 Topps Chrome RayWave Refractor #2024 Jose Caballero Tampa Bay Rays Card
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText: This sports trading card features Jose Caballero, a Major League Baseball player. The card is part of the 2024 Topps Chrome set and has a RayWave Refractor parallel/variety. It is a great addition to any baseball fan's collection, especially those who admire Jose Caballero's skills on the field. The card is manufactured by Topps and is not vintage. The card number is #USC24 and it is a single card.
